rubric:
Stage 4: NucEvolve-Bench difficulty audit (Benchmark v1, read-only).

Difficulty is assigned from *engineering structure* only -- plant size, fault
count, fault type, task family, and whether the design point is checked at more
than one operating point.  No NucEvolve score is used, so the split cannot be
tuned to flatter the method.

Rubric (frozen before any model result is inspected)
-----------------------------------------------------
Easy      one fault (or an assemble with none), <= 8 connections, fault is a
          single dropped wire, family repair/assemble.
Medium    <= 15 connections, one fault of any kind, family repair/assemble/tune.
Hard      > 15 connections, OR a fault that requires choosing the *correct*
          source among several (swap_connect / replace_connect / wrong_source),
          OR family multistep/diagnose.
Challenge two or more simultaneous faults, OR >= 24 connections (the scale of
          the largest 13-instance plant in Benchmark v1).

Structure novelty (a separate axis, per §9.5):
  seen_structure  the (template, structure-hash) exists in the evolution split
  new_combination template seen, structure hash new
  new_template    template never seen in evolution
  new_component   the plant uses a component type absent from evolution
